_comment: USB delivery, no download server. Native custom assets (apiBundle/neo4j/jre/snapshot/projectData) are read from an `assets/` folder on the USB by filename; electron/scripts/build-release.ps1 fills in the sha256 (blank = verification skipped, for dev). The Ollama installer + base models still come from the internet. apiBundle is the folder-signature file. Build-pipeline contract: apiBundle unzips to <userData>/api/emb-api.exe + _internal/, neo4j to <userData>/neo4j/bin/..., jre to <userData>/jre/bin/. See docs/DECONTAINERIZE_PLAN.md (Workstream E).
